propositions: rebar_repo fixture function-scoped init is 47% of tests/interfaces wall-clock (306ms per test across 589 consumers) due to subprocess-heavy git operations; session-scoped template with per-test copytree reduces this to 22.3ms

copied repos must fix four sharing axes: rewrite worktree pointers (.tickets-tracker/.git and gitdir), set REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR per test, re-randomize .env-id and .signing-key, and reset ensures._pending_cache
template fixture must build inside isolated MonkeyPatch context with REBAR_ROOT pinned to avoid autouse environment contamination leaking into the cached template
tier-wide autouse guard must reject any store whose git worktree list paths fall outside REBAR_ROOT; bare git worktree repair is proven inadequate and can corrupt source
half-fixed copies (only .tickets-tracker/.git rewritten, gitdir stale) must be rejected by the guard; full-fixed copies must pass
deliberately un-templated tests (test_init_idempotent_scratch.py, test_e4_init.py) must build from scratch to preserve coverage of the init-from-nothing path
